top_signals.title: CXMT Rival YMTC Moves Closer to China’s Next Marquee Chip IPO
top_signals.summary: Yangtze Memory Technologies Co. moved closer to an initial public offering in China, following in the footsteps of rival CXMT Corp.’s near-record share sale.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Borrowing costs hit multi-decade highs
top_signals.summary: Fears over inflation and mounting public debt ignite bond sell-off
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Chinese Coking Coal Futures Soar as Shanxi Supply Crunch Worsens
top_signals.summary: Chinese coking coal prices are surging as supply continues to tighten after the deadly accident in the mining hub of Shanxi three months ago.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: The U.S.-Canada natural gas and electricity trade value rose in 2025
top_signals.summary: Although the total value of energy trade between the United States and Canada fell by 11% in 2025 to an estimated $137 billion, according to data from the U.S. Census Bureau, the trade value of natural gas and electricity between the two countries increased slightly primarily because of increased natural gas prices and trade volume.
